planner_entry_activity_check.name: planner_entry_activity_check
planner_entry_activity_check.value: ("planner_entry"."activity_start" is null and "planner_entry"."activity_end" is null) or ("planner_entry"."activity_start" is not null and "planner_entry"."activity_end" is not null and "planner_entry"."activity_end" >= "planner_entry"."activity_start")

content_card_event_stage_check.name: content_card_event_stage_check
content_card_event_stage_check.value: (from_stage is null or from_stage in ('ide', 'draft', 'review', 'disetujui', 'tayang')) and (to_stage is null or to_stage in ('ide', 'draft', 'review', 'disetujui', 'tayang'))

content_card_event_note_check.name: content_card_event_note_check
content_card_event_note_check.value: kind not in ('kembali', 'batal_centang') or note is not null

content_card_media_kind_check.name: content_card_media_kind_check
content_card_media_kind_check.value: media_kind is null or media_kind in ('image', 'video')

content_card_media_provider_check.name: content_card_media_provider_check
content_card_media_provider_check.value: provider is null or provider in ('youtube', 'drive', 'tautan')

content_card_media_shape_check.name: content_card_media_shape_check
content_card_media_shape_check.value: (source = 'file' and object_key is not null and media_kind is not null and mime is not null and size is not null and original_name is not null) or (source = 'embed' and url is not null and provider is not null)

service_request_diajukan_check.name: service_request_diajukan_check
service_request_diajukan_check.value: "service_request"."status" <> 'diajukan' or ("service_request"."follow_up" is null and "service_request"."planner_entry_id" is null and "service_request"."decided_by" is null and "service_request"."decided_at" is null)

service_request_disetujui_check.name: service_request_disetujui_check
service_request_disetujui_check.value: "service_request"."status" <> 'disetujui' or ("service_request"."follow_up" is not null and ("service_request"."follow_up" = 'planner') = ("service_request"."planner_entry_id" is not null))

service_request_ditolak_check.name: service_request_ditolak_check
service_request_ditolak_check.value: "service_request"."status" <> 'ditolak' or ("service_request"."manager_note" is not null and "service_request"."follow_up" is null)

service_request_dibatalkan_check.name: service_request_dibatalkan_check
service_request_dibatalkan_check.value: "service_request"."status" <> 'dibatalkan' or ("service_request"."manager_note" is not null and "service_request"."planner_entry_id" is null and "service_request"."cancelled_staff" is not null)

loan_item_resolve_needs_problem.name: loan_item_resolve_needs_problem
loan_item_resolve_needs_problem.value: "loan_item"."problem_qty" > 0 or ("loan_item"."resolved_at" is null and "loan_item"."resolved_by" is null)
